meta.description: Which language keys NAME which glossary concept. A key listed here cites the concept id (glossary.json terms[].concept); generate_translation_payloads.php hands the translator that concept's definition as the source for the key, with English as one rendering of it. A key may cite more than one concept. A key also cites a concept through an existing `gloss: <term>` pointer in $ec_lang_syn, so it is not repeated here. Checked by concept_check.php: every key must exist in lib/lang.ec.en.php and every id must exist in glossary.json. Design: dev/term-concepts.md (ROADMAP Task 737).
